items.title: Music
description: I have been an occasional {{DJ}} at country estates and private events for 5 years.
I am an {{electronic music}} enthusiast, especially genres such as Makina, Hard Bounce, Hard Groove and Hard Techno, among others like Drum & Bass and Hardcore.

description: I edit photos and video with {{Lightroom}}, {{Photoshop}}, {{Premiere Pro}}, {{DaVinci Resolve}} and the {{Affinity}} suite.
In the process of starting a {{YouTube}} channel to upload videos about film and my own horror short films.
